Character system · v3

59 items, 3 stats, one economy

Every number here is the same one the prototype uses. Habits pay coins and XP and unlock the day’s trips; Health and Power win adventures, Stamina catches rarer fish; coins buy gear; gear raises the odds.

How stats work

Health and Power win adventures. Each place tests its own mix of the two (see Adventures), so the right outfit depends on where the hero goes.
Health counts most at Mushroom Hollow and Ember Caverns.
Power counts most at Coral Coast and Frost Peaks.
Stamina is the fishing stat: more Stamina, rarer fish. It does nothing on adventures.
Base per level: Health 40 + 8, Power 6 + 2, Stamina 30 + 3. Level n to n+1 needs 100 × n XP.
XP: +10 per full check-in, +5 per minimum (max 60 a day), plus adventures and +5 per fish.
Item budget: Starter 2, Common 4, Rare 8, Epic 13, Legendary 20 stat points (1 point = 4 Health = 1 Power = 2 Stamina). Same rarity = same total. Every item is the best of its slot and rarity for at least one job: one of the six places, or fishing.

Coins and prices

Habits: +10 full check-in, +5 minimum, +20 all done. Max 60 a day. Fixing past days pays nothing.
Badges: +50 for each new streak badge.
Trips: an adventure win pays 8 to 56 coins by place, +25% if every habit was done before the trip. Duplicate fish sell for 2 · 6 · 18 · 50 coins by rarity.
Prices: Common 150 · Rare 400 · Epic 800 · Legendary 1,500. Hair: 120 · 300 · 600 · 1,200. Cost per stat point rises with rarity (37 to 75).
Lures: Shiny 60, Golden 200 coins, one trip each. The worm is free.
Level gates: Rare Lv 3 · Epic Lv 5 · Legendary Lv 10.
Rewards, never for sale: streaks unlock Trailblazer Boots (7 days), Knight Armour (14), Knight Helmet (1 month), Phoenix Wings (3 months), Royal Crown (1 year); Fish Book rows and the league unlock the five items above.
Store total: 20,310 coins.

Gaps to fill next

Coin sink: lures are the first one. After the store is bought out (about day 154 to 363) coins still pile up: add item upgrades, seasonal items or more lures.
New places: a regular player reaches the last place around day 50 (dedicated 41, casual 95). Add places, bosses and fishing spots past Lv 10.
Income mix: trips pay about 62% of a regular player’s coins by day 90 (habits 42 of 110 a day). Trips only unlock through habits, so habits stay the engine; watch it with real data.
League: players are simulated in the prototype. A real league needs matchmaking by level and activity, and anti-cheat beyond the daily caps.
Art: prototype quality. Every item uses one 22 × 32 layer template, so an artist can redraw piece by piece.

Mushroom Hollow330 minHealth 67%Power 33%1514–20 coins · 30 XP5%
Coral Coast445 minHealth 33%Power 67%1518–26 coins · 40 XP6%
Frost Peaks51 hHealth 33%Power 67%1826–34 coins · 55 XP6%
Ember Caverns82 hHealth 67%Power 33%3234–44 coins · 70 XP7%
Dragon's Spire104 hHealth 50%Power 50%3744–56 coins · 90 XP8%
Score = (Health ÷ 4 × H + Power × P) ÷ (H + P), with H and P the test weights above. Win chance = score ÷ rec − 0.25, kept between 10% and 95%, so a hero at the recommended score wins 3 times in 4. A loss still pays 25% of the coins and 50% of the XP. A regular player starts each new place at about 66–70% (Whispering Woods 75%). One adventure a day, unlocked by finishing half of the day’s habits.
